prompt: A greenhouse records a completion only when both the morning watering and the evening vent check occur on the assigned day. A rain closure pauses, rather than breaks, a streak; an unfinished open day breaks it. Nia finished Monday, Wednesday was open but the vent check was unfinished, and her only other two assigned days this week are Tuesday’s rain closure and a fully completed Thursday, so the log now shows _____.
promptZh: 溫室只有在當天完成早上澆水及晚間通風檢查才算完成。因雨關閉時會暫停連續紀錄，不是中斷；正常開放日未完成則會中斷。妮雅週一全數完成，週三開放但漏做通風檢查；本週另外只排了因雨關閉的週二及全部完成的週四，因此紀錄現在顯示_____。

options.text: an unbroken three-day streak, since Wednesday morning’s work counted
options.zh: 連續三天未中斷，因週三早上工作也算完成
options.whyZh: 只有完成早晚兩項才算，週三不能計入。

options.text: an unbroken two-day streak joining Monday and Thursday, since Tuesday was closed
options.zh: 週一和週四連成兩天未中斷，因週二關閉
options.whyZh: 週二因雨暫停不打斷，但正常開放的週三漏檢，已中斷。

options.text: no completed streak, since every calendar gap breaks it
options.zh: 沒有完成的連續紀錄，因行事曆上凡有空日就中斷
options.whyZh: 週四完整完成，故已有新的第一天。

options.text: a new one-day streak starting on Thursday
options.zh: 週四起重新開始，連續完成一天
options.whyZh: 週二暫停，週三中斷，週四完成後開始新的一天。

explanationZh: 週二暫停，週三中斷，週四完成後開始新的一天。
evidence: rain closure pauses, rather than breaks, a streak / an unfinished open day breaks it / the vent check was unfinished / a fully completed Thursday

vocabulary.note: 指同類事件連續發生的一段紀錄，常與開始、中止或延續搭配。
